1. at the furthest point , and so either topmost = Lat. summus, or outermost = Lat. extremus:

3. outermost , ἄκρη χείρ, ἄκροι πόδες, ἄκρος ὦμος the end of the hand, ends of the feet, tip of the shoulder, (Iliad by Homer); ἐπ᾽ ἄκρων [ δακτύλων] on tiptoe , (Sophocles Tragicus); ἄκροισι…
